content.comment_body: Dear forum participants, designated experts now have the option to create and assign TAGs or keywords to individual posts. I've started utilizing this feature more recently, which some members may have noticed—TAGs are displayed beneath the post's title if any have been assigned. By clicking a TAG, a list of all related contributions appears. Currently, there's no publicly available central list of TAGs. Therefore, I'm sharing this post to provide an overview of all TAGs I have created and assigned in the English section of the [product_name] forum, including those I plan to assign in the future. Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: This message explains how TAGs or keywords help organize and find relevant content within the forum, particularly for the [product_name] area. The writer notes that the lack of a centralized TAG list makes quick access to categorized discussions more difficult. No technical or user experience problems relating to [company_name] products are mentioned.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks a comprehensive, easily accessible central list of all TAGs or keywords used in the forum's [product_name] section to improve information search and organization.
